gallery.title: File:Festival Omed-omedan Setelah Nyepi.jpg
gallery.description: Omed-omedan is 'The Kissing Ritual' ceremony held by the young people of Banjar Kaja Sesetan, Denpasar, Bali. The name is derived from the Balinese language and means pull-pull. The man and the woman are held by their friends towards each other to finally sing and hug. People will also shoot some water to them.
